details:
Bug Description:

When using VR in VRChat, I am unable to make wrist cuff accessories appear identical on both hands. The accessory settings, transforms, and configuration are set to be the same on each wrist, but the cuffs display differently between the left and right hands.

I have attempted to manually match the position, rotation, and scale of both wrist cuffs multiple times, but they continue to appear misaligned or visually inconsistent. This issue persists while using PC-VR and makes it difficult to achieve symmetrical accessory placement.

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Launch VRChat in PC-VR mode.

2. Equip or configure wrist cuff accessories on both hands.

3. Attempt to make both cuffs identical by matching their settings and positioning.

4. Observe that the cuffs do not appear identical despite using the same values.

Expected Result:

Both wrist cuffs should appear visually identical when given the same settings, position, rotation, and scale values.

Actual Result:

The left and right wrist cuffs appear different or misaligned even when configured identically.

Platform:

PC-VR

Additional Notes:

The issue has persisted after multiple adjustment attempts and does not appear to be caused by user error in accessory configuration. This also began after the accessory bundles were released.
title: Accessories Won't appear identical on both arms for some platforms.
